description_en: 🏡 Modern Villa for sale - Sauk, behind the Animal Hospital 📍 Location: Sauk, behind the Animal Hospital 📐 Construction area: 180 m² 🌳 Land area: 300 m² 🌿 Quiet area with natural lighting throughout the day 🚗 Possibility of parking for 4 positions inside the yard The villa is built to high standards and furnished with an architect. ✨ Main features 🪟 Tempered triplex windows 🔥 Multisplit heating system 🏠 Outside hood system 🪵 Parquet with engineered wood 🔥 Functional fireplace 📹 Security camera system 🧱 Yard surrounded by concrete wall and railing 📦 Basement -1 (30 m²) and technical storage 🏊 Possibility to build a swimming pool according to the project 🏠 Organization of the villa Floor 0 🛋️ Living room 🍳 Separate kitchen with window 🛏️ Bedroom for friends 🚿 Large main toilet with laundry 1st floor 🛏️ 2 bedrooms 🚿 2 large toilets 👗 2 wardrobe rooms 2nd floor 🌅 Terrace with veranda 🌳 View from Lake Tirana 🚿 1 toilet 🌿 Yard 🚗 4 parking spaces 🔥 Barbeque area 📦 Basement -1 (30 m²) ⚙️ Technical warehouse 📐 The project also provides space for the construction of a swimming pool.
